stale version cannot commit model output

unreported attempts retain both token holds

conflicting usage cannot overwrite accounting
second action cannot dispatch before the first is resolved
UNKNOWN still blocks the second action

cancel fences the former observation writer
cancelled in-flight work remains recoverable

late SUCCESS event retains action outcome instead of run state
cancellation cannot schedule another model step
complete compensation stays a business failure outcome
actual remote DB was charged and refunded once
legacy cancellation cannot terminate over a second pending effect
late known-failure event is not replaced with CANCEL_REQUESTED

decision cannot cross Agent binding

cancelled unissued approval stays terminal
